description: Everything decided for this posture, and nothing else. GPT-6-Astra at `xhigh` with detailed reasoning summaries; fully autonomous through `approval_policy = "never"` plus `sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access"`, which is exactly what `--yolo` sets (`--full-auto` was removed at 0.155.1). `model_reasoning_effort` is not optional: unset sends `none`, which Astra rejects outright before the agent answers (openai/codex#44184). The window is 872000 -- this account's `max_context_window`, 95% of it usable at 828400 -- with compaction at 700000, which is 84.5% of usable and inside the 80-85% band published guidance recommends; the widely quoted 1.05M is the API model's window, not this build's. Subagents are off through `agents.enabled`, the documented control that removes every collaboration tool from the prompt, while the `multi_agent` feature flag changes the prompt by zero bytes and is kept only because it flips a flag other code paths read. Live web search, because Astra's cutoff is 2026-04-30. Memory across sessions enabled in both directions, which is durable state in CODEX_HOME. Budgets sized by arithmetic rather than copied: `tool_output_token_limit = 32000` lands a ~125 KB file whole and still allows 21 such reads before compaction, which matters because with no subagents a truncated read cannot be delegated; `project_doc_max_bytes` doubled to 65536 because the default truncates instructions silently. `shell_environment_policy.inherit = "all"` is the default, written down because the built-in KEY/SECRET/TOKEN filter does not cover SSH_AUTH_SOCK -- so the agent socket reaches every command the model runs. Browser and app access opened explicitly. Telemetry off.
